integrity: Analytical proof with transparent Hölder equality arguments; finite Python scalar checks are corroboration, not proof. No independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Assumes origin-symmetric full-dimensional factors and orthogonal block direct sums. Identifies the two canonical ellipsoids and their contact sets but does not claim the Banach–Mazur minimizing ellipsoid. Residual possibility of a classical equivalent direct-sum theorem; independent validation not performed.
title: Entropy law and opposite contact transitions for the canonical ellipsoids of direct sums
